western/aspects/orbs.yaml.method: Inclusive deviation. Major natal, synastry and composite contacts take the larger point adjustment once. Minor aspects and timed contacts retain base widths. Quincunx is opt-in including explicit Yod geometry.

provenance.composite: Editorial reuse of synastry orbs and adjustments.

western/personal-horoscopes/compose.yaml.daily: Select a personal transit approaching perfection today, show the natal point and local date. Weekly lists dated contacts in chronological order and groups repeat passes.
western/personal-horoscopes/compose.yaml.selection: Filter exact passes to [local start,next local start). Group repeats by mover, target and aspect, preserving dates. Sort by date then ID. Withhold unproved angles. Use selected pair text or the existing aspect family for faster movers.
western/personal-horoscopes/compose.yaml.separation: General sign-wide content has its own label and index.
western/personal-horoscopes/compose.yaml.tone_policy: One contact one contribution. Support alone gives Supportive; caution alone gives Take care; both or neither give Steady. Context and neutral do not vote. Empty eligible set withholds the reading.

techniques.essential_dignity: Select domicile, exaltation, triplicity, term and face tables for the same historical school.
techniques.house_rulers: Use classical domicile ruler of each cusp sign. Outer co-rulers require a separate convention.
techniques.profections: Advance one sign from the rising sign per completed year at the solar anniversary, modulo twelve. Use its ruler; withhold without a reliable rising sign.

auxiliary_points.chiron: Compute geocentric tropical Chiron only when local ephemeris data are available; otherwise unknown.
auxiliary_points.fortune: Day uses (ASC + Moon - Sun) modulo 360. Night uses (ASC + Sun - Moon) modulo 360. Use solar centre geometric altitude at the observer, day at or above zero. Missing sect or Ascendant withholds Fortune.
auxiliary_points.interpretation: Chiron, nodes and Fortune are display-only. Reliable angles have their own contact rules and remain outside planetary pattern membership.
auxiliary_points.mc_ic: Use actual meridian MC from Swiss angles and IC opposite even in equal and whole-sign charts.
auxiliary_points.nodes: Compute mean ascending node; descending node is opposite modulo 360.

houses.assignment: Normalize to a turn. Include the start cusp and exclude the next cusp in zodiac order. Whole sign begins at zero of the rising sign. Equal begins at the Ascendant degree.
houses.polar_failure: For failed Placidus or Koch discard any automatically substituted cusps. Recompute whole sign from a valid stable tropical rising sign. Otherwise withhold house-dependent results.

western/profile.yaml.longitude: Geocentric apparent ecliptic longitude of date. Normalize to [0,360). Signs are equal half-open sectors starting at the March equinox.
western/profile.yaml.minor_aspects: Quincunx is opt-in for standalone and Yod queries.
western/profile.yaml.outer_planets: Use the existing KB-02b entries and their personal-contact filters; sign placements alone supply cohort context.
western/profile.yaml.patterns: Distinct natal bodies from the ten-planet list only; apply all required edges to the same instant. Canonicalize by member set and apex. A maximal sign cluster counts once.
western/profile.yaml.phase_index: For secondary lunar phases take floor(((progressed Moon minus progressed Sun) mod 360)/45). Index zero begins at conjunction. A change is a solved crossing of a sector boundary.
western/profile.yaml.point_interpretation: Stable ASC and MC support personal contacts. MC describes public work and IC private foundations. Chiron, nodes and Fortune remain display-only.

public.evidence: Bodies, orbs, exact times, house method and pattern members are available for chart evidence. No score in public copy.
public.label: Western (tropical)
public.selection: Cooperative testimony may give Supportive; tension needing attention may give Take care; mixed or neutral testimony gives Steady. Use only supported natal or timing facts. Omit unresolved readings.

western/profile.yaml.quincunx: Enable the minor aspect for stand-alone quincunx or Yod queries.
western/profile.yaml.timing: Use five major aspects by default, and opt-in quincunx. Solve exact oriented branches and station tangencies. Retain all dated passes; withhold when a natal target is unknown.
